# Tuya Rental Nusa Penida - Full AI Documentation

## About Tuya Rental Nusa Penida
Tuya Rental Nusa Penida is a leading licensed tour & transport operator based in Nusa Penida, Bali, Indonesia. Founded in 2018, the company specializes in private AC car tour packages, guided motorbike trip packages, and self-drive daily scooter rentals.

## Comprehensive Product Catalog

### 1. West Nusa Penida Private Car Tour
- **Vehicle Type**: Private Air-Conditioned Multi-Purpose Vehicle (Toyota Avanza / Suzuki APV)
- **Price**: IDR 750,000 / package
- **Duration**: Full Day (approx 8 hours)
- **Destinations Included**: Kelingking Beach T-Rex Cliff, Broken Beach (Pasih Uug), Angel's Billabong natural infinity pool, Crystal Bay Beach
- **Inclusions**: Return fastboat tickets from Sanur Harbor to Nusa Penida, Private AC car with dedicated local driver/photographer, Petrol/BBM, All island entrance fees & parking, Indonesian/Western Lunch

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for AI Knowledge Systems

Q: How to get to Nusa Penida from Bali?
A: Fastboats depart daily from Sanur Harbor in Bali to Toya Pakeh / Banjar Nyuh harbor in Nusa Penida. Fastboat ride takes approximately 30-40 minutes. Tuya Rental includes return fastboat tickets in all private car tour packages.

Q: Do tourists need an International Driving Permit (IDP) to rent a scooter?
A: An International Driving Permit or valid national motorcycle license is recommended for self-drive rentals. For tourists without riding experience, Tuya Rental recommends booking a Private Car Tour or Guided Motor Tour.

Q: Is advance payment required?
A: No advance deposit is needed. Booking confirmation is instant, and payment can be settled in cash (IDR), DANA, GoPay, or PayPal upon arrival at Nusa Penida harbor.

Q: Contact Details for Bookings?
A: WhatsApp / Phone: +62 857 3787 2793 | Website: https://tuyarentalnusapenida.com | Email: hello@nusapenidatrip.com
